findings.reason: as written the node can go green with an assertion that never runs, and the plan must name review_self_refused as the record to read.
findings.text: the assertion on "the refusal reason in each report" reads `reports`, but a refused self-promotion is routed into review_self_refused and is explicitly kept out of `reports` (recovery_review_acceptance.py:1042-1048, "kept in its own list rather than in ``reports``), so a loop over report["reports"] is a loop over an empty list and passes vacuously

findings.reason: the headline number in the Why is log growth, and the installed measure cannot show that growth stops.
findings.text: the deliverable requires the refusal to be "logged once per signature", but the done-when counts only the calls to _delivered_review_record and never the log line; the cost the Why measures is 19,920 `station-sweep-run-failure` lines, and an implementation that memoises the record search while still reporting the refusal at every pass satisfies the stated count and leaves the log growing

findings.reason: the worker must be told the pointers are ended with dead pids and a worker record, or the control reads 0 and the node cannot show the walk happened at all.
findings.text: the negative control "at the base revision the count is 40" is asserted over "40 terminal pointers" without the fixture that makes each pointer reach the walk: _env_scan_run_pid is entered only after the pointer's recorded pid fails on this host and the run's record shows a worker existed (recovery_liveness.py:1454-1486, reached from classify_pointer at recovery_classification.py:1232), so 40 terminal pointers with live pids walk zero times at the base revision and the stated control cannot be produced from the section's own description

findings.text: "refused each time at reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:756-764 with 'the review run stored no readable record …'" points at promote_review_run's deferral and gate-report block; the refusal text is emitted by review_self_state at :846-852 and returned from promote_review_run_itself at :891-899
